title: mattpocock/skills
notes: Reference that shaped Scout — the single-plugin-marketplace "subscribe, not fork" pattern and the user-invoked/model-invoked axis come from here. Plugin route recorded as primary because it stays current; skills.sh copy-and-own also documented (npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills), then `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@mattpocock` and a one-time /setup-matt-pocock-skills per repo. Only the promoted surface (README + plugin-manifest skills list) is recorded; misc/personal/in-progress buckets are the author's private workbench.
summary: Matt Pocock's curated agent-skills collection for engineering workflow: alignment interviews (grill-with-docs, grill-me), red-green-refactor TDD, spec implementation, architecture review, and handoff documents — promoted skills bucketed under engineering/ and productivity/ and split user-invoked vs model-invoked. Distributed both ways on purpose: skills.sh copies files to hack on; the Claude Code plugin (the repo is its own marketplace) is a read-only, auto-updating subscription.
surfaces_when: starting a sizeable feature where requirements should be pinned down by an alignment interview before any code
running a test-driven (red-green-refactor) implementation loop with an agent
producing a handoff document or a codebase-architecture improvement plan
ambient_line: mattpocock/skills — Matt's engineering-workflow skills; use for alignment interviews, TDD, handoffs.
